notes.text: The Ta’anit witness reads Tanhum Adreya in the dew-vow discussion.
The parallel Berakhot witness has Tanhuma with Adreya bracketed as a place-name. “One of Adreiah’s inhabitants” is the edition’s explanation.
The two named variations occur in their respective digital witnesses.
